nodes.title: SG-5.4 · Mocked-storage unit tests for frozen export and FrozenIDs
nodes.body:
Context: the contribution package already has Exporter (backend/internal/contribution/exporter.go), the Export JSON types (export.go) and FileStore.FrozenIDs (store.go). Desired behavior: unit tests with mocked storage cover the export JSON format, the empty round, frozen-only inclusion, and the frozen-ids reader, and they pass. Expected result: `go test` in the contribution package passes with those tests present. Why: the frozen-contribution handoff to devion workseed must stay stable.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the contribution package, When go test runs, Then the export format, empty round, frozen-only and FrozenIDs tests exist and pass
- Given the tests, When they run, Then no real network, git or disk outside t.TempDir is used


## Scope
- In scope: Unit tests in backend/internal/contribution
- Out of scope: New export fields
- Out of scope: Changes to other packages
- Preserve: Existing Export JSON shape
- Preserve: Existing exporter and store behavior


## Technical constraints
- Go tests, mocked ExportSource and fake committer


## Definition of done
- Tests exist and pass in the contribution package


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Exporter JSON format, frozen-only inclusion and empty round are covered by mocked-source tests
nodes.body:
Context: Exporter.Export filters ListByRound results by FrozenIDs in snapshot order, returns a non-nil empty slice for an empty round and wraps source errors. Desired behavior: fake-source unit tests assert the JSON format, frozen-only inclusion, empty round and error propagation. Expected result: tests pass. Why: protects the handoff contract.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given contributions A,B,C and frozen ids C,A, When Export runs, Then only C then A are returned with Author, Content and CreatedAt mapped
- Given no frozen ids, When Export runs and is JSON-encoded, Then it contains "contributions":[]
- Given a failing source, When Export runs, Then errors.Is matches the source error
- Given an Export value, When marshaled, Then the JSON keys match the documented format


## Scope
- In scope: exporter.go behavior
- In scope: export.go JSON shape
- Out of scope: FileStore
- Preserve: Export JSON field names and ExportVersion


## Technical constraints
- Use the fakeSource and errSource doubles


## Definition of done
- Exporter tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · FileStore.FrozenIDs reader is covered by temp-dir tests
nodes.body:
Context: FileStore.FrozenIDs reads snapshot.yaml for a world and round and returns the ids in order, ErrNotFound when missing and an error for unsafe path segments. Desired behavior: unit tests cover these three cases. Expected result: tests pass. Why: the exporter relies on it.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a snapshot.yaml listing a then b, When FrozenIDs runs, Then it returns [a b]
- Given no snapshot, When FrozenIDs runs, Then the error is ErrNotFound
- Given world ../x or round a/b, When FrozenIDs runs, Then a non-ErrNotFound error is returned


## Scope
- In scope: store.go FrozenIDs
- Out of scope: Exporter
- Preserve: Snapshot YAML format


## Technical constraints
- Filesystem only under t.TempDir; fakeCommitter for git


## Definition of done
- FrozenIDs tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None
